Actually wait — cycle 2 vs cycle 12: "HH-0001-2:12" last two chars "12" ≠ ":2". Fine.

- Payment model has household_id, amount, key fields — yes, from disburse.

- The script replaces verify_cycle2.py — does that file exist? The item says "replace the whole of scripts/verify_cycle2.py". The ticket asks to write disburse_cycle2.py and run it.
